## Description

Federate hospital IdP; SSO-enforced tenant; SCIM create/update/deactivate users; grants table user × role × facility scope × expiry; locum grants with end dates; licence count; quarterly access review.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Deactivating a user in the hospital IdP removes Medvya access within the SCIM cycle.
- [ ] **AC2.** Role alone never grants another facility (tests).
- [ ] **AC3.** Expired grants end access automatically.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
